svg.title: QuickSnip — Select. Press C. It’s on your clipboard.
svg.desc: A fast, keyboard-first screenshot tool for macOS. A looping demo shows a capture: Command Shift K dims the screen, an area is selected, an arrow and a step number are drawn with the A and N keys, and pressing C copies it to the clipboard.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: A fast, keyboard-first screenshot tool for macOS.
Capture, mark up and copy without reaching for a toolbar.
macOS 14 or later · Apple Silicon and Intel · Free
